newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romanian President Emil Constantinescu said better ties between Romania and Poland could play a key role in bilateral cooperation and integration in CEFTA structures.

* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea ended talks with World Bank representatitves of the World Bank mission on current Bank projects in Romania. Ciorbea also said negotiations with IMF experts on a new loan accord will start on January 16.
* Senate adopted draft bill on projects related to Romania's nuclear power sector.
* Gouvernment and trade unions started talks on package of social protection measures.
